title: AGENTGUARD AI
short_desc: Real-time security proxy gateway that detects and blocks tool-use abuse, privilege escalation, and prompt injection attacks in autonomous AI workflows.
long_desc: AgentGuard AI is an enterprise-grade security gateway designed to protect autonomous LLM agents and multi-agent workflows from prompt injection, malicious tool calling, unauthorized data exfiltration, and privilege escalation. Featuring real-time token stream inspection, embedding-based semantic anomaly detection, and granular zero-trust policy enforcement across distributed multi-agent systems.
tech_stack: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch, React, Vector Embeddings, Chart.js
highlights: Real-time bidirectional proxy intercepting agent input and execution calls
Dynamic prompt injection classification and malicious payload quarantine
Role-based privilege escalation prevention across autonomous agent tools
Interactive monitoring telemetry dashboard with security event timelines

title: Student Mental Health & Depression System
short_desc: Machine learning diagnostic engine combining psychometric assessment (PHQ-9 / GAD-7) with NLP feature extraction to predict depression risks and deliver intervention pathways.
long_desc: A research-driven predictive decision-support system built to assist student welfare counseling and early mental health intervention. Combines standardized clinical psychometric instruments (PHQ-9 and GAD-7) with natural language sentiment feature extraction to categorize risk levels and provide tailored wellness guidance.
tech_stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Random Forest, Flask, SQLite, Pandas
highlights: Validated psychometric scoring integrated with unstructured text reflections
Random Forest & SVM ensemble classifiers with multi-class risk categorization
Complete data privacy and client-side encryption of sensitive health records
Automated clinical reporting with contextual emergency referral triggers

title: AI Finance Controller
short_desc: Autonomous financial intelligence platform utilizing time-series forecasting, expense anomaly detection, and automated cash-flow optimization.
long_desc: An algorithmic financial controller that models consumer and enterprise cash-flow patterns, forecasts future capital trajectories using autoregressive time-series models, and isolates abnormal spending spikes using Isolation Forest anomaly detection algorithms.
tech_stack: Python, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Flask, Chart.js, SQLite
highlights: Autoregressive time-series cash-flow modeling and forecast curves
Isolation Forest unsupervised anomaly detection on transaction streams
Recurring expense fingerprinting and subscription drift alerts
Interactive data visualizations and exportable budget breakdowns

title: Full-Stack Personal Portfolio
short_desc: Minimalist Swiss-inspired creative engineering portfolio with interactive Three.js 3D architectural centerpiece, fluid motion, and Python Flask backend.
long_desc: Engineered with a minimalist Swiss design philosophy inspired by Denny Pratama's portfolio. Blends high-contrast editorial typography, an interactive WebGL Three.js geometric computing centerpiece, cursor-tracked project previews, and an enterprise-grade Python Flask / SQLite backend with Google Sheets & email notification pipelines.
tech_stack: Python, Flask, Three.js, GSAP, SQLite, CSS Grid, WebGL
highlights: Interactive 3D architectural centerpiece responding to cursor movement & scroll
Swiss editorial typography hierarchy with bespoke serif & sans pairings
Cursor-following floating image hover cards on tabular project showcase
Secure SQLite contact backend with email alerts and Sheets sync pipeline

title: Machine Learning Research & Prediction Suite
short_desc: Comprehensive suite of predictive models including multi-symptom disease prediction (94% accuracy) and social sentiment NLP classification using BERT.
long_desc: An applied machine learning research laboratory featuring two production-tested systems: (1) An empirical symptom-based disease prediction model built with Random Forest and SVM ensembles achieving 94% validation accuracy, and (2) A transformer NLP pipeline leveraging fine-tuned BERT and VADER for real-time sentiment distribution analysis.
tech_stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Transformers, BERT, NLTK, Pandas
highlights: High-accuracy disease classifier evaluating complex symptom constellations
Transformer sequence classification with sub-20ms inference latency
Comparative feature importance analysis across multiple model families
Modular Python pipeline with reproducible dataset pipelines and training scripts
